claim_scope: Exact convolution singular-value multiset for determinant-weighted triples of inverse quadratic pencil chirps over F_p^d, odd prime p and dimension d>=2, provided all three pencil members are nonsingular; prime-three rank and sharp equality, and p>=5 conditioning for rank(V)>=2.
integrity: Original mathematical inputs are standard quadratic Gauss sums and finite-field quadratic-form counts; independent certification is not claimed. Verification code checks finite examples only.
limitations: No claim for singular pencil members, arbitrary mixing coefficients, or generic convolution filters. Rank-one V uses the general spectral multiset, not the simplified condition number. Historical priority risk remains.
title: Prime-three collapse and exact spectra of three-chirp inverse pencils
